name: Fix SmolAgent tool loop
description: The conversation identified an infinite loop where the SmolAgent repeatedly requested the same tools three times. The root cause was non-normalized tool arguments causing cache misses. The fix involved modifying `_parse_tool_arguments` to sort JSON keys deterministically. This ensures the tool cache correctly reuses results, preventing redundant calls. The change is minimal, non-breaking, and resolves the looping issue without altering other behavior.
